d.title: Katekyou Hitman Reborn! Vongola Family Soutoujou! Vongola Shiki Shuugakuryokou, Kuru!!
d.en: Reborn! Here Comes a Vongola Family-Style School Trip!
d.jp: 家庭教師ヒットマンREBORN! ボンゴレファミリー総登場! ボンゴレ式修学旅行、来る!!
syn: Katekyou Hitman Reborn! Jump Super Anime Tour 2009 Vongole Shiki Shugakuryoko, Kuru! The Complete Memory
d.synopsis: An internet-only stand-alone special episode of Katekyou Hitman Reborn! on the Shounen-Jump website, where the main characters go to various tourist spots in Japan. It will be made available on DVD in July 2010, and extra scenes will be included.
